To secure assets and ensure physical safety, we must immediately: (1) review and diversify financial portfolios, prioritizing liquidity and resilient assets against market downturns and credit tightening; (2) fortify critical supply chains and physical infrastructure against social unrest and resource scarcity, particularly focusing on water and essential goods; and (3) activate and review comprehensive emergency preparedness protocols for seismic events, ensuring personnel and key assets in vulnerable regions are ready for sudden physical disruptions.
